searchText: In regards to Jin's statement, the Chainsafe Team's Ethereum 2 Light Client Prototype can be found here: https://github.com/ChainSafe/eth2-light-client-demo Will come back tomorrow with more information about this (currently in conversation with Chainsafe). Cool - I also started pulling some draft notes together on this topic - WIP but perhaps useful as a basis for study group discussions? https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-one/blob/master/notes/j-cook/beacon-light-client-network.md @Jeremy Akatsa#0957 let me/us know if there is a good time for you to connect this week 😊 Hi team! Updates: Just spoke with the Teku(Consensys) team about the Java logic protocol portion of the light client… They said they don’t need one (in leu to Chainsafe’s light client demo), but, are open to having one so I’ve decided to continue the build (and hopefully finish before the CDAP program ends). What they need is the light client server infrastructure built into their already running Teku protocol: https://github.com/ConsenSys/teku/issues/4230 so I’ll be working on this in parallel. In conclusion: **I’ll be working closely with the Teku team at Consensys moving forward.** I’ll hop on here for any additions/updates/questions etc. Let me know if you all have any questions. Thanks.
